description: This file implements the NativeJSPlugin class, which manages the lifecycle of a NativeJS plugin within the WPEFramework. It includes initialization, deinitialization, and information reporting functionalities, and interacts with external components such as INativeJS and the environment.

classes.name: NativeJS
classes.description: A class managing the NativeJS plugin lifecycle, including initialization, deinitialization, and providing plugin information.

methods.name: NativeJS::NativeJS
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the singleton instance pointer.

methods.name: NativeJS::Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the NativeJS plugin, sets up environment, and registers the plugin.

methods.name: NativeJS::Deinitialize
methods.description: Cleans up the plugin, unregisters, and releases resources.

methods.name: NativeJS::Information
methods.description: Returns a JSON string with plugin information.
